summary: Frontend-only verification of two Iter 617 employee-PWA features: (1) auto-uppercase address inputs on /profile-edit and (2) custom web CROP modal on /profile-photo with zoom controls and base64 upload. Both features work end-to-end. Also ran light regression: name field NOT force-uppercased, cancel-crop path (no upload), and 'Remove photo' still works.
critical_code_review_comments: profile-photo.tsx: `compressImage()` (lines 31-47) is unused since Iter 617 (only onCropDone uploads now). Consider removing to reduce bundle size, or keep as a helper if future non-crop paths need it.
profile-edit.tsx is 1142 lines — well over the 700-line guideline. Consider extracting the Family-members block, Address block and pending-request card into separate components.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login flow: /pin-login is Mobile-tab default; click 'Username' text (right edge of the label to avoid overlapping Mobile tab hit-area works, or the visible label locator once page settles). TEST50 / 123456 lands on '/' (home). Deep-linking to /profile-edit and /profile-photo works from that state. Address auto-uppercase is implemented via t.toUpperCase() onChangeText in profile-edit.tsx (lines 402-407 & 447). Web-only crop modal at profile-photo.tsx CropModal (lines 54-167) opens after expo-image-picker returns an asset when Platform.OS==='web'. File-chooser is a hidden <input type=file> and can be driven via page.expect_file_chooser().
